name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: An Alchemist can learn to craft a Mana Well from Alchemist Mallory near Stormwind. It gives healers and spellcasters a refreshing taste at camp.

sections.title: A Camp for Brews
sections.body: An Alchemist can ask Alchemist Mallory near Stormwind in Elwynn Forest to teach a camping craft. You need to show proficiency in your skill before learning to make a Mana Well. Healers and spellcasters can come to the camp for a refreshing taste.

sections.title: Setting Up Camp
sections.body: Once you know the craft, you can make your own Mana Well. Camps belong in the wilderness, and a campfire is needed before you start one. Someone who trains cooks can teach you the basics of making a fire.

faq.q: Who teaches Alchemists to make a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Alchemist Mallory teaches the craft near Stormwind in Elwynn Forest, once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

faq.q: What is a Mana Well for?
faq.answer: A Mana Well gives healers and spellcasters a refreshing taste at camp.

faq.q: Where can I find Alchemist Mallory?
faq.answer: Alchemist Mallory is near Stormwind in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before starting your camp. Someone who trains cooks can teach you how to make a fire.

faq.q: Where should I try out my Mana Well?
faq.answer: Try it in the wilderness, since most folk do not care for camps in the center of town.
